lines.en: For a moment, I wondered if I'd gone a little too far.
I'd meant to say something along those lines, but I hadn't intended to provoke him this much.
Maybe I'd grown too used to staging satisfying moments for the constellations. It was ridiculous. I wasn't Yoo Joonghyuk, and right now there wasn't even anyone giving me coins.
“Did you hear that? The Demon King of Salvation!”
Jang Hayoung said, bouncing up and down beside me.
“That constellation must be in our channel! The person who was on Earth!”
I was about to explain that I was that very ‘Demon King of Salvation’ when a recent memory suddenly came to mind.
―Oh, maybe he already has a girlfriend.
······No, that wouldn't do.
Instead, I looked up at the sky, where light had been flashing for a while.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ is throwing a fit.]
The bastard seemed pretty pissed.

But throwing a fit wouldn't get him anywhere. ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss’ was, at best, a constellation of low Status. He had neither the guts to manifest in the Demon Realm nor the probability to bear the cost.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ is enraged that a mere incarnation has insulted him!]
······A mere incarnation?
Who was it that killed this bastard in the original novel?
It wasn't Yoo Joonghyuk, at least······.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ is indignant that an unheard-of constellation has opposed his wishes!]
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ looks around for the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’]
He didn't even seem to realize that I was the same person as that ‘Demon King of Salvation.’ Well, it didn't matter either way.
As long as he paid attention to the ‘Demon King of Salvation,’ half my objective would be achieved.
「Kim Dokja thought. It's about time to gather constellations in the channel. That way, I can gain an advantage in the ‘Demon King Selection’ that follows the ‘Revolutionary Scenario.’」

I'd deliberately revealed my modifier to him because I needed someone to spread word of the channel. But recruiting constellations indiscriminately was dangerous, too. If overly powerful ones flocked here from the start, it could be hard on Biyoo and put me in a difficult position.
And just then, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss’ had appeared in the channel.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ begins asking nearby constellations about the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’]
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ is startled by the rumors about the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’]
He was a vulgar, low-class sort, even among the Historical-grade constellations of other worlds.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ claims to have seen the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’]
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ protests that the barrage of criticism from the constellations is unfair.]
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ insists that he really saw the ‘Demon King of Salvation’!]
That was why the lofty Narrative-grade constellations wouldn't believe him. In other words, his connections extended only to constellations of similarly low Status.
In other words, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss’ was just the right bastard to gather those low-Status constellations.
[The constellation. ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ gathers his gang.]
Just as I'd expected.
[New constellations have entered channel #BI-90594.]
If ‘Secretive Plotter’ had been in the same channel, there would've been a message about being impressed by my scheme or something. I found myself missing that a little.
[The newly arrived constellations reveal their modifiers.]
[The constellation, ‘Nail-Eating Rat,’ searches for the incarnations' shed fingernails.]
[The constellation, ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames,’ shows curiosity about the incarnations in the channel.]
Judging by the all-animal lineup of modifiers, he seemed to have brought his friends.

‘Nail-Eating Rat’ and ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’······ I felt I could tell who they were from their modifiers without even recalling ‘Ways of Survival.’ So even creatures like those became constellations.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ warns the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’]
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ declares that the nebula Twelve Zodiacs (十二支) is taking over this channel.]
······Well, would you look at that?

I'd seen the Twelve Zodiacs mentioned in passing in Ways of Survival. They were one of the nebulas, but they weren't particularly close-knit. Most of their members were low-Status constellations, too. Making enemies of them probably wouldn't be much of a problem.
「Kim Dokja thought. Well, the number of subscribing constellations has increased. Is rounding out the lineup next?」
As a channel grew, so did the number of loaches muddying its waters.
I couldn't use my Status freely right now, so I needed a constellation to manage the channel's water quality for me.
A powerful constellation who was reasonably well-mannered and could crush bastards like those······ Where would I find someone like that?
In fact, I already had the answer.
“Jang Hayoung, what are you doing?”
Jang Hayoung, who had been busily typing something into the air, flinched and looked at me.
[The ‘Unidentifiable Wall’ flinches.]
Even their behavior had grown alike in that short time.
I narrowed my eyes slightly and said,
“Tell the other constellations about the ‘Demon King of Salvation’ and you're dead.”
“I was just going to brag a little about hearing his message······.”
“You'll get divine punishment for that. The ‘Demon King of Salvation’ is a very, very scary person.”
Whatever Hayoung made of my words, they glanced up at the sky with a start. Apparently, they thought the ‘Demon King of Salvation’ might be watching them from somewhere.
Fortunately, there was no unusual activity in Biyoo's channel. It seemed Hayoung hadn't spouted any nonsense yet. Watching my reaction, Hayoung asked,
“Do you know much about the ‘Demon King of Salvation’?”
“Just a little.”
“Are you close?”
Should I say we were close or that we weren't······?
“Close enough to tell on you if you do something stupid.”
“······Are you going to tell?”
“Depends on how you behave.”
Now that the subject had come up, I thought it was actually good timing.
After all, from here on, I would have to use Hayoung's power.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ searches for somewhere to vent his anger.]
[The constellation, ‘Nail-Eating Rat,’ shows curiosity about you.]
Indirect messages sounded from the air one after another. After listening quietly for a while, Duke Syswitz spoke with a frown.
“Gather all the nobles when night falls.”
“Pardon? But······ U-understood!”

Terrified by the duke's expression, the officer hurried out of the office. Duke Syswitz took out a fresh cigarette and put it between his lips. Perhaps because it had been so long since he'd heard a constellation's indirect message, he seemed slightly anxious.
‘I don't know who the hell opened the channel. But I can't let this opportunity pass.’
It wasn't an official channel. But whatever kind of channel it was, if he could use this situation, he could begin the selection from the most advantageous position in the ‘73rd Demon Realm.’
‘The other dukes probably haven't obtained channels for interstellar broadcasts yet.’

The snake and rat modifiers troubled him a little, but they were constellations all the same. He didn't know the full circumstances, but this situation was undoubtedly a golden opportunity for him to become a ‘Demon King.’
Marquis Ombros, who had been watching, asked,
“Surely you don't intend to face the ‘Revolutionary’ when you cannot even operate the ‘Factory’?”
“Once all the remaining Executioners die, the Revolutionary will gain the power to kill you.”
A Ruler who lost all his followers would become the revolution's dew.
That was the course this ‘Revolutionary Scenario’ was meant to take.
But Duke Syswitz didn't so much as twitch an eyebrow.
“Of course. If the one who has appeared is the ‘real Revolutionary,’ that is.”
“What do you mean······?”
“Incidentally, have you decided which side you'll take?”
“Pardon?”
Ombros blinked in surprise.
“I am a marquis of Gilobat······.”
Seeing Duke Syswitz's quiet smile, Ombros suddenly understood what he meant by ‘side.’
“Have you decided?”
Beads of cold sweat dampened Ombros's back.
A flicker of indecision crossed his mind.

The first duke to obtain a ‘channel’ in this war would have an overwhelming advantage in the selection. Soon, countless constellations would flock to this channel. Besides, Syswitz already possessed the most powerful Story in the 73rd Demon Realm······.
Ombros didn't deliberate for long.
“I greet the new Demon King of the Demon Realm.”
It was a decision befitting a ‘demon.’
Duke Syswitz nodded as Ombros slowly sank to his knees.

After leaving the Removal Slaves in Aileen and Mark's care, I asked Biyoo to disrupt the broadcast channel briefly. It was a precaution against possible trouble. There was nothing to be gained by letting our animal friends hear what I was about to say.
“Jang Hayoung, how many people are you talking to right now?”
Hayoung gauged my reaction before answering.
“About three?”
“One must be the Black Flame Dragon. Who are the other two?”
“Um······. Actually, it might be five.”
“Five?”
“To be precise, about nine, but······.”
“If you count the ones who take a while to reply, maybe fifteen······?”
The ‘Unidentifiable Wall’ had several distinctive functions.
One of them was the one-on-one chat Hayoung had unlocked not long ago.
An incredible ability to send messages to anyone with a modifier who belonged to a scenario in the <Star Stream>.
But having that ability didn't mean everyone could do what Hayoung did.
“You talked to fifteen people in that short time?”
“Well, it wasn't that hard?”
I found it hard enough to talk to one person.
Those were some truly impressive multitasking skills.
In that short time, as many as 15 constellations and transcendents had struck up conversations with Hayoung. Those proud bastards······.
You might wonder how that was possible, but this was Hayoung's true ability. It was precisely this ability that would later allow Hayoung to build a faction of transcendents.
Studying my face, Hayoung asked,
“But why do you ask?”
For a moment, I hesitated.
This choice was crucial.
If I made the wrong choice here, the channel I'd worked so hard to obtain could be ruined in an instant.
After thinking for a moment, I slowly spoke.
“There's someone I'd like you to invite.”
“Huh? Who?”
But when I actually tried to say it, my hesitation grew.
For a moment, I wasn't sure my choice was right.
「Kim Dokja thought. With my current power, I can't control the ones I'm about to invite.」
Getting this far had been truly difficult.

The damned scenarios were bad enough, but what had tormented me most were actually the constellations. The ones who issued ‘bounty scenarios’ at every opportunity were the least of it. Come to think of it, I'd ended up in the Demon Realm because of the [Fate] they'd imposed on me.
Even now, remembering that time made me tremble with rage and lose sleep.
After all that painstaking effort, I'd reached this remote stage and opened a new channel.
And now I was going to invite one of those bastards here again······?
“······Why aren't you saying anything?”
Surely there were good constellations in the world, too.
Constellations I'd seen and read about through ‘Ways of Survival.’
Or constellations I'd come to reassess, however slightly, after ‘Ways of Survival’ became reality.
But whatever they seemed like, their essential nature as ‘constellations’ remained unchanged.
Whatever my expression looked like, Hayoung's eyes filled with concern.
“······Did I do something wrong?”
“No, it's nothing like that.”
“Then is something bothering you?”
For some reason, I felt uncomfortable talking about it and gave a small shake of my head. Hayoung looked me straight in the eye and said,
“I like listening to stories.”
Those strangely familiar words made me let out a small laugh.
I took another careful look at Hayoung's face.
Snow-white skin and a well-defined nose. Gently curving eyebrows and clear, deep eyes······.
Something like a faint sense of guilt gradually knotted in my chest.
「I'd like someone who likes stories.」
「Yoo Joonghyuk has everything going for him, so this character should have had a fair taste of reality's bitterness······.」
「Joonghyuk doesn't listen to anyone. So how about making this character someone who's good at listening to other people?」
The result of every comment I'd scribbled was right before my eyes.
With eyes to see the world, a nose to breathe through, and ears to hear stories.
Perhaps it was the guilt, but the first words slipped out before I realized it.
“There were people I thought were bad.”
“People?”
I nodded and continued.
“Most of them were pretty rotten. Some bullied people or bad-mouthed them, and some even did truly horrible things.”
After quietly listening, Hayoung asked me,
“From the way you're talking, you must've really hated them?”
“······That's what I thought, but I'm not sure.”
Perhaps my true feelings had slipped out without my noticing.
“Some were better than I expected, and some acted differently from what I'd known of them.”
The countless passages of ‘Ways of Survival’ I'd read over the years drifted through my mind.
“Which version of them is real. Which side is reality, and how much of it is fake. I can't really tell anymore.”
Despite my uncertain phrasing, Hayoung quietly listened. How much time had passed? After thinking something over carefully, Hayoung asked me,
“It's hard to understand exactly what's bothering you······ But you mean you want to know more about those people now, right?”
“What?”
“They seemed like bad people, but maybe some of them are actually good. You've started hoping for something like that. Haven't you?”
Had it sounded that romantic?
I felt the urge to object, but on reflection, I thought that might be the issue.
Hayoung nodded and said,
“At times like that, all you can do is talk. Try talking to them.”
“Talking won't do any good.”
“Why?”
“It's just······.”
I couldn't explain it well. It was a helplessness I couldn't put into words.
But sometimes, people are most honest when they are most helpless.
“Because I think everyone has a huge wall.”
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ looks at you.]
“You and I are talking like this, but we probably aren't really communicating. I think there's no such thing as ‘communication’ in this world.”
[The ‘Unidentifiable Wall’ looks at you.]
「Kim Dokja thought. Maybe it's all the same, whether it's reality or a novel.」
「If it's something I still don't understand after reading for so long.」
「Perhaps I'll never understand it.」
Was I imagining it? For an instant, my surroundings seemed to distort, and I felt as if everything were turning into printed words.
The illusion shattered with Hayoung's words.
“I'm a different being from anyone else. Of course something like that can't happen.”
“What?”
“Everyone has a wall, and communication is impossible······ Isn't that obvious?”
To think that the friendly, sociable Hayoung thought that way. It was a little unexpected.
But Hayoung continued.
“You still have to try talking. Even if there's a huge wall, it means the other person is there on the other side.”
“······How do you talk when there's a wall?”
“You write on the wall.”
At that brazen answer, my mouth fell open.
“Smear shit on it or piss on it—leave something on the wall. Something the other person can recognize.”
“Why would you do that? The other person is on the other side of the wall anyway······.”
“Leave something anyway.”
“What's the point?”
“There isn't really a point.”
“Then?”
“What matters is simply that you left something.”
“But the other person won't know anyway?”
“At least the wall has changed.”
For a moment, I had no words. Hayoung spoke firmly.
“Then maybe someone will read it someday.”
I gazed quietly at Hayoung.
Jang Hayoung had been born into this world because of my selfish wishes. Yet even though I was the reason they had been born, they were living a life unrelated to mine.
And perhaps Hayoung had become an even better person than I'd imagined.
For some reason, that fact left a bitter taste, and I smiled.
“There's something I want to ask.”
“Did you give the constellations advice like this, too?”
Judging by that hesitant tone, it seemed I'd guessed right.
I could understand a little of how those constellations felt.
The most exalted beings in this universe, yet lonely at the same time.
Beings with as much to say themselves as they had stories to watch.
Hayoung had probably listened to them just as Hayoung had listened to me.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ looks around for the insolent incarnation!]
Hayoung and I looked up into the air at the same time.
Thanks to Biyoo's disruption of the channel, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss’ hadn't been able to locate me for the time being. Of course, that wouldn't last very long, either.
Hayoung asked anxiously,
“······Is that bastard planning to stay here?”
“Probably.”
After being humiliated in the channel, he was probably itching for revenge.
After a little thought, I finally made my decision.
Hayoung was right. If there was a wall, I had to write something on it.
Even if that changed something already written there······.
I no longer wanted to be someone who only read.
“Jang Hayoung, could you get in touch with this one for me?”
Come to think of it, I'd been acting that way all along.
I'd been creating new stories so I could see the ending I wanted.
When it came down to it, I'd already been enthusiastically scrawling something.
Though I still didn't know who would end up reading it.
“Who is it?”
I didn't know whether this constellation would accept my proposal.
But now that the channel was open······ If that constellation would just help, the rest of the ‘Revolutionary Scenario’ would end without much trouble.
Then, suddenly, a message sounded from the air.
[The ‘Fifth Night’ has arrived.]

An ominous sound of a flute. Without realizing it, I turned toward the [Industrial Complex]. People were screaming amid the rising inferno (火魔). My face set, I spoke to Aileen and Mark, who were elsewhere nearby.
“Tell all the citizens to gather.”
The duke had been cornered.
The fact that the fourth [Night] had passed without incident made that clear.
We'd abducted the [Removal Slaves] and cut off the power that ran the Factory. Even the duke wouldn't be able to act rashly for a while unless he had more guts than sense.
Yet that very duke had willingly led his nobles out into this [Night].
「Kim Dokja thought. What the hell is he planning?」
With the new constellations entering the situation as another variable, my thoughts were a little tangled. Besides, I still hadn't invited any constellations who would take our side.
「Enough. Think positively. This could actually be an opportunity.」
Right. There was no need to lose my nerve.
I was a full-fledged constellation now, too.
I'd done well so far, so there shouldn't be any problems.
“Jang Hayoung! Take care of the Executioners! Don't fight any of the other nobles!”
“Got it!”

Using [Way of the Wind], I raced through the air and reached the street where the largest flames were burning. How far had I run? Soon, I came face-to-face with a demon standing atop the spire of a shattered building.
“Are you the Revolutionary?”
A long-haired demon wrapped in red flames.

The heat rising from his entire body stung my face. The prickling energy of explosive flames. Seeing the flames swell and blur into yellow, I thought I recognized this power. Only one being in the 73rd Demon Realm used this kind of Story.
“Marquis Omboros.”
A demon second only to the dukes in power in the 73rd Demon Realm.
Before becoming a constellation, I would've hesitated to take him on.
But Omboros had an odd expression.
“It's Ombros, not Omboros.”
Aha, apparently I'd gotten his name wrong.
But even I, Kim Dokja, hadn't memorized the names of every extra.
His pride apparently bruised, Omboros continued muttering.
“You know who I am, yet you don't run······ I thought you were destined for a long life, but you seem less fortunate than I expected.”
“I'd have run if I thought I'd lose. Omboros.”
“I said it's Ombros······!”
Instead of answering, I drew up the magic power inside me.
Last time, I'd fought using a constellation's Status. But those opponents had been easy pickings. Against someone on Omboros's level, merely releasing my Status wouldn't create an opening.
So this time, it would be an all-out battle.
[Bookmark No. 5, ‘Kyrgios Rodgraim,’ is activated!]
[Activating the exclusive skill, ‘Miniaturization Lv.3’!]
[The exclusive skill, ‘Electrification (電人化) Lv.11(+1),’ has been activated.]
KABOOOOM!
Yellow explosive flames burst from Omboros's clenched fist.
It was his signature Story, Explosive Flame Ring (爆裂煥). One of the foremost explosive stigmas in the 73rd Demon Realm. It was powerful, but not particularly difficult to evade.
The explosion covered a wide area, but its actual strikes were spread thin.
“You little rat······!”
[The constellation, ‘Nail-Eating Rat,’ is disgusted by the demon Ombros's remark.]

Perhaps finding it difficult to fight my shrunken form with a simple Explosive Flame Ring, Omboros changed tactics. The explosive flames rising from both his hands rapidly contracted, then began to take the shape of small balls.
“Die!”
The condensed Explosive Flame Rings burned even more fiercely in his hands. Apparently, he intended to reduce their area and overwhelm me with force······.
It was a good plan, but this time he'd picked the wrong opponent.
He should've tried that on an ordinary incarnation.
ROOOOAR!
Watching his Explosive Flame Ring approach, I thrust my fist forward without hesitation.
The blow, into which I'd poured all the magic power I could, tore a deep hole in the center of the incoming Explosive Flame Ring.
For an instant, my ears rang. Fragments caught in the explosion scattered through the air in a spectacular display.
BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!

The inferno engulfing our surroundings was swept away, its flames extinguished. All that filled the space around us was electricity imbued with White Pure power. I thought I heard a drawn-out cry of Uuuuugh―and then my vision flashed white.
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ is appalled by your power.]
Omboros was nowhere to be seen where the White Pure electricity had swept through.
He might have been flung far away······ Or perhaps he was dead.
The sight of the mercilessly devastated industrial complex.
Some citizens who had witnessed my power were on their knees, seemingly overwhelmed.
At this point, even I couldn't accurately gauge how well I could fight now. Once I properly returned to the scenarios, couldn't I beat most constellations in a one-on-one brawl?
[You have used a level of power your incarnation body cannot withstand.]
[Your incarnation body has sustained substantial damage!]
······Damn it, here we go again.
Still, it was all right. My days of living in a tattered incarnation body would soon be over.
“WAAAAAAH!”
Had the situation emboldened them?
The citizens around me rose one by one and let out a collective cheer.
“Revolutionary! Revolutionary!”
[New constellations are entering the channel!]
The sound of the constellations increasing in number.
It felt different from when I'd grown the channel with Bihyung.
Probably because I thought of this as ‘my channel.’
I moved to the front of our battle line and cut down the approaching nobles indiscriminately.
“WAAAAAH!”
By crawling out without the [Factory], the duke had brought this scenario's end upon himself. Amid the waves of furious citizens, the nobles' forces were gradually ground down.
How much time had passed?
At last, the [Factory]'s main gate came into view.
“The revolution is almost here! If we go just a little farther······!”
Someone shouted those words.
But the next moment, an earthquake began deep underground.
Rrrrrumble.
The startled citizens screamed and sank to the ground. I saw something rise before my eyes. The enormous building, which had been sleeping quietly like an old beast, was getting to its feet.
BWOOOOOOO!
The sound of an engine reminiscent of a steam engine. Black exhaust filled the sky, and a horn tore at my eardrums. My heart sank.
······The [Factory] had activated?
How?
But there was no time to think.
Before I could prepare, something like an enormous fist struck me.
WHAAAAM! KABOOOOM!
I smashed through several buildings, leaving them half-destroyed, and was buried beneath collapsed steel beams.
For a moment, I lost consciousness, then came to.
[Your incarnation body's Stories have sustained severe damage!]
[Consume a new Story or enter a main scenario!]
Blood gushed from my incarnation body, and the Stories throughout it shook out of balance.
Damn it. My thoughts had been so tangled that I'd apparently let my guard down.
To make a mistake like this······.
But no matter how I thought about it, I couldn't understand.
How the hell had the [Factory] activated?
[The constellation, ‘Nouveau Richer Snake Boss,’ delights in the state you're in.]
[The constellation, ‘Nail-Eating Rat,’ enjoys your ordeal.]
[A very small number of constellations wish to see you suffer even greater pain.]
Damn them.
After all the trouble of opening a channel, not one of those bastards was on my side.
As I gritted my teeth and rose, I heard a familiar name.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ watches you closely while clutching his hair.]
······Really?
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ studies your face.]
The Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, had really come?
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ narrows his eyes at your clothing.]
Feeling that gaze for the first time in so long gave me a strange sense of security.
For my mind and body to relax simply because someone was watching me—it was a truly strange feeling.
“Prisoner of the Golden Headband.”
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ looks at you.]
The Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, still seemed uncertain.
As if he wasn't quite sure whether I was Kim Dokja.
Perhaps it was because I'd covered my face with a Story.
After a moment's thought, I decided to put his doubts to rest.
“Yes. It's me.”
For an instant, silence hung in the air.
A silence as though the sky had abruptly drawn in a breath.
Then, a moment later.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ is shocked by your identity!]
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ asks how on earth you are still alive.]
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ wonders why you are in a place like this.]
Messages directed only at me, as if they would blanket the sky.

「The Great Sage, Heaven's Equal. A neutral constellation aligned with neither Absolute Evil nor Absolute Good. Playful yet indifferent, a being whose innate rebellious streak kept him from easily associating with any constellation······.」
That was the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, I knew from ‘Ways of Survival.’
One of the strongest constellations in ‘Ways of Survival’ in every sense, who would fight countless constellations toward the end of the work and accumulate absurdly powerful Myth-grade Stories.
Yet a being who had died alone, never forming a deep bond with anyone, even to the very end.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’······.]
Listening to the Great Sage's messages, I slowly closed my eyes and opened them again.
It was important to trust the information I had. But.
“Great Sage, Heaven's Equal.”
Bzzzzzt.
“······I'm glad to see you again.”
For quite a long time, the Great Sage said nothing.
Even though I'd become a constellation like him, he was still someone I could neither see nor touch. Yet in that moment, I felt as if the Great Sage were right in front of me.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ moves his lips for a long while.]
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ repeatedly grasps and releases his hair.]
Bzzzzzt!
Then, the next moment, something drifted gently down through the air.
What I caught without thinking was.
······None other than [A Hair of the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal].
A smile crept onto my face.
Perhaps this was the Great Sage's way of trusting someone.
[Your understanding of the constellation character, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ increases slightly.]
I spoke to the Great Sage.
“The fact that I'm here is a secret. You know that, right?”
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ nods.]
He was a more tight-lipped constellation than I'd expected, so he would keep the secret well.
“By the way, how did you find this······?”
Before I could finish, one wall of the collapsed building tilted, and someone burst in. Jang Hayoung appeared amid a shower of loose dust.
Fortunately, Hayoung seemed to be unharmed so far.
“Yoo Joonghyuk! Are you all right?”
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ looks puzzled.]
Come to think of it, I was still trading on Yoo Joonghyuk's name.
It was about time to tell Hayoung my real name, too······.
For now, I asked about the situation outside.
“How are things outside?”
“······Not very good.”
In fact, the sounds alone gave me some idea of what was happening.
An earthquake that seemed to shake the entire industrial complex.
As the citizens' screams sounded from all around us, Hayoung's expression grew even grimmer.
“The duke is tearing the [Industrial Complex] apart looking for you.”
It would've been strange if he weren't tearing it apart.
At this point, if the duke had activated the [Factory], there was no way to stop him.
Still, I couldn't give up now.
“What happened to the Executioners?”
“There's only one left now. That one's really good at running away······.”
Hayoung was cloaked in a Fighter's aura, with demon blood smeared on one cheek.
Even so, taking down two in that short time was a remarkable achievement.
“Please take care of the last one, too. Only then—the duke······.”
Bzzzzzt!
As I continued speaking, faint sparks flickered across the surface of my face.
My knees suddenly lost their strength.
Hayoung rushed over in alarm and grabbed my shoulders.
